entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: Defensive: every SpansetExpression the parser can place as a set-operation operand (SpansetFilter, SpansetOperation, Pipeline) is handled above, so the default branch is unreachable from a parseable query.

guard: past exhaustive switch v := e.(type) over [case *traceql.SpansetFilter; case *traceql.SpansetOperation; case traceql.SpansetOperation; case *traceql.Pipeline; case traceql.Pipeline]
